```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(loo)
library(tidybayes)
library(posterior)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
theme_set(theme_bw())

set.seed(1007)
```

This notebook will analyse the outputs of the Bayesian models fitted in
the previous notebook. Analysis will include: (1) LOO model comparison, (2) phylogenetic ICC calculation.

```{r All nedded functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# LOO check
loo_safe <- function(fit, ndraws = 1000, moment_match = FALSE) {
  # Try regular PSIS-LOO on a thinned log-lik; fall back to add_criterion
  tryCatch(
    {
      ll <- log_lik(fit, ndraws = ndraws)
      loo(ll)
      },
    error = function(e) {
      if (moment_match) {
        add_criterion(fit, "loo", moment_match = TRUE, ndraws = ndraws)$criteria$loo
        } else {
          stop(e)
        }
      }
  )
}

# tidy loo outputs
loo_compare_tidy <- function(loos_named) {
  cmp <- loo::loo_compare(loos_named)
  df <- as.data.frame(cmp)
  df$model <- rownames(df)
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  dplyr::relocate(df, model) |>
    dplyr::rename(elpd_diff = elpd_diff, se_diff = se_diff)
}

# Pareto-k diagnostics summary
pareto_summary <- function(loo_obj) {
  k <- loo::pareto_k_values(loo_obj)
  tibble(
    n = length(k),
    frac_k_gt_0.5 = mean(k > 0.5),
    frac_k_gt_0.7 = mean(k > 0.7),
    max_k = max(k)
    )
}

# Pick LOO-best model
pick_best_model <- function(loo_tbl) {
  loo_tbl |> arrange(desc(-elpd_diff)) |> slice(1) |> pull(model)
}

# For kable
kbl_c <- function(x, caption = NULL) {
  kable(x, format = "html", digits = 3, caption = caption)
}

# Compute ICC_phylo from a brms fit
icc_phylo_brms <- function(fit, other_re_prefixes = c("FG","CAS","latin")) {
  dr <- as_draws_df(fit)
  
  # phylogenetic variance (intercept RE)
  v_phy <- dr$`sd_phylo__Intercept`^2
  
  # residual variance
  v_res <- dr$sigma^2
  
  # sum other random-intercept variances if present
  v_other <- 0
  for (p in other_re_prefixes) {
    nm <- paste0("sd_", p, "__Intercept")
    if (nm %in% names(dr)) v_other <- v_other + dr[[nm]]^2
  }
  
  icc <- v_phy / (v_phy + v_other + v_res)
  tibble(icc = icc)
}

```

# 1. Load Bayesian model output files

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
chem_groups <- c("Arthropod_control", "Auxiliary_other",
"Fungal_control", "Vertebrate_control", "Plant_control", "Mixed_multitarget")

model_ids <- c("M1","M2","M3","M4")

fits <- list()
for (g in chem_groups) {
  fits[[g]] <- list()
  for (m in model_ids) {
    path <- here::here("model_output", paste0("fit_", m, "_", g, ".rds"))
    if (file.exists(path)) {
      fits[[g]][[m]] <- readRDS(path)
    }
  }
}

#lapply(chem_groups, function(g) lapply(fits[[g]], summary))
for (g in chem_groups) {
  cat("\n\n## ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
  mods <- fits[[g]]
  if (is.null(names(mods)) || any(names(mods) == "")) {
    names(mods) <- paste0("M", seq_along(mods))
  }
  for (nm in names(mods)) {
    cat("\n### ", nm, " (", g, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    tab <- summary(mods[[nm]])
    if (is.data.frame(tab) || is.matrix(tab)) {
      print(kable(tab, format = "html", digits = 3))
    } else {
      print(tab)
    }
  }
}

```

# 2. LOO check

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nd <- 1000
moment_match <- TRUE

loo_results <- list()
loo_tables  <- list()
k_diags     <- list()

out_dir <- here::here("model_output", "loo_check")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (g in chem_groups) {
  message("Computing LOO for: ", g)
  lm <- list()
  for (m in names(fits[[g]])) {
    message("              ", m)
    lm[[m]] <- loo_safe(fits[[g]][[m]], ndraws = nd, moment_match = moment_match)
  }
  loo_results[[g]] <- lm
  
  # Tidy LOO comparision table
  tbl <- loo_compare_tidy(lm)
  loo_tables[[g]] <- tbl
  
  # Pareto-k diagnostics
  kd <- purrr::map_dfr(
    names(lm),
    ~ pareto_summary(lm[[.x]]) |> dplyr::mutate(model = .x),
    .id = NULL
  ) |>
    dplyr::relocate(model)
  k_diags[[g]] <- kd
  
  # ---- save per group ----
  purrr::iwalk(lm, ~ saveRDS(.x, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("loo_", g, "_", .y, ".rds"))))
  readr::write_csv(tbl, file.path(out_dir, paste0("loo_table_", g, ".csv")))
  readr::write_csv(kd,  file.path(out_dir, paste0("pareto_diag_", g, ".csv")))
}

# save all groups together
saveRDS(loo_tables,  file.path(out_dir, "loo_tables_all.rds"))
saveRDS(k_diags,     file.path(out_dir, "pareto_diags_all.rds"))

```

Print LOO tables and Pareto-k diagnostics

loo_tables <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "loo_tables_all.rds"))

for (g in chem_groups) {

  kable(k_diags[[g]], digits = 3,

}

# 3. Choose the best model from LOO and then compute phylogenetic ICC

We calculate the phylognetic signal
$ICC=\sigma_{\text{phy}}^{2} / (\sigma_{\text{phy}}^{2} + \sigma_{\text{res}}^{2})$
from the LOO-best model for each chemical group.

```{r}
icc_draws <- list()
icc_summ  <- list()
winners   <- list()

for (g in chem_groups) {
  best <- loo_tables[[g]] |> filter(elpd_diff == 0) |> slice(1) |> pull(model)
  winners[[g]] <- best
  fit_best <- fits[[g]][[best]]
  
  # compute ICC from best model
  icc_df <- icc_phylo_brms(fit_best, other_re_prefixes = c("FG","CAS"))
  icc_draws[[g]] <- icc_df |> mutate(group = g, model = best)
  icc_summ[[g]] <- icc_df |>
    summarise(
      median = median(icc),
      l95 = quantile(icc, 0.025),
      u95 = quantile(icc, 0.975)
      ) |>
    mutate(group = g, model = best)
}

icc_draws_df <- bind_rows(icc_draws)
icc_summ_df  <- bind_rows(icc_summ)

icc_dir <- here("model_output", "ICC_phylo")

saveRDS(icc_draws_df, file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_draws.rds"))
saveRDS(icc_summ_df,  file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_summary.rds"))
saveRDS(winners,      file.path(icc_dir, "icc_winners_by_group.rds"))

```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Present ICC distribution only:
# ---- LOAD cached ICC outputs ----
icc_dir <- here::here("model_output", "ICC_phylo")

# Figure: posterior ICC by chemical group

  ggplot(aes(x = icc, y = forcats::fct_rev(group))) +
  tidybayes::stat_slab(aes(thickness = after_stat(pdf)), normalize = "area") +
  tidybayes::stat_pointinterval(.width = c(0.5, 0.95)) +

       y = "Chemical group") +

  ggplot(aes(x = icc, y = forcats::fct_rev(group))) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(.width = c(0.5, 0.95), normalize = "panels") +
  labs(x = "Phylogenetic signal ", y = "Chemical group") +
 # coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(icc_plot)

ggsave(filename = file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_plot.png"),
       plot = icc_plot, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)

```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#Present LOO comparisons and ICC together for possible Figure 3:
# ---- Figure: (A) LOO comparison, (B) ICC by chemical group ----
out_dir <- here::here("model_output", "loo_check")
icc_dir <- here::here("model_output", "ICC_phylo")

loo_tables   <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "loo_tables_all.rds"))
k_diags      <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "pareto_diags_all.rds"))
icc_draws_df <- readRDS(file.path(icc_dir, "icc_phylo_draws.rds"))

# ---- Build panel (A): Δ elpd vs best (forest style) ----
loo_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(loo_tables, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x, group = .y), .id = NULL) |>
  dplyr::mutate(model = factor(model, levels = sort(unique(model))))

fs <- 14

pA <- ggplot(loo_df, aes(x = elpd_diff, y = model, color = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = elpd_diff - se_diff, xmax = elpd_diff + se_diff), height = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = expression(Delta ~ "elpd"[loo]), y = "Model") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_extended(n = 5),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1, big.mark = ","),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +
  guides(x = guide_axis(check.overlap = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = fs) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = fs),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", size = fs),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    strip.text.x     = element_text(size = fs),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA)
  )

# ---- Build panel (B): ICC posteriors by group ----
pB <- ggplot(icc_draws_df, aes(x = icc, y = forcats::fct_rev(group), color = group, fill = group)) +
  tidybayes::stat_halfeye(.width = c(0.5, 0.95)) +
  #coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Phylogenetic signal", y = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = fs) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = fs),
    axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", size = fs),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black")
  )

# ---- Combine and save ----
fig_LOO_ICC <- pA + pB +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")")

print(fig_LOO_ICC)

ggsave(here::here("plots/LOO_ICC.png"),
       fig_LOO_ICC, width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

k_sum <- k_df |>

    n_group          = dplyr::first(n),
    max_k_group      = max(max_k, na.rm = TRUE),

  dplyr::mutate(model = factor(model, levels = sort(unique(model)))) |>
  dplyr::left_join(k_sum, by = "group") |>

    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    strip.text.x     = element_text(size = fs-2, face = "bold"),

# ---- (B): ICC posteriors ----

fig_LOO_ICC <- pA + pB +

 # patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")")
